adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic.rb`, `expandable_first_post?` changes from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. Since this PR removes the `embeddable_hosts` site setting and replaces it with the `EmbeddableHost` table, the equivalent “embedding configured” guard would now need to be something like `EmbeddableHost.exists?` (or similar). As written, if `embed_truncate` remains enabled and a topic already has an embed (`has_topic_embed?`), the first post will be treated as expandable/truncated even when there are zero allowed `EmbeddableHost` records (i.e., embedding has been effectively disabled via the new mechanism). That is a concrete behavior change introduced by this diff.
